none: PAS LIN-DC69C2: Roman nummus of Magnentius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [D N MAGNEN-TIV]S P [F AVG] ; R/ SA[LVS] DD [NN AVG ET CAES]

A very worn and incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Magnentius, dating to the period AD 352-353 (Reece period 18). SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES reverse depicting a Chi-Rho flanked by alpha and omega. Gallic mint. Obverse description: Bare-headed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [D N MAGNEN-TIV]S P [F AVG]. Reverse description: Chi-Rho between alpha and omega. Reverse inscription: SA[LVS] DD [NN AVG ET CAES]. Diameter: 23.26 mm; Thickness: 2.13 mm; Weight: 3.73g
